Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Please put the trips in a table with date, pickup time and place, passenger, driver, and any return detail. Mrs Ellis needs a ride to the clinic on Tue 15 Oct; pickup is 8:30 am at 12 Mill Lane, and her return time is not known yet, so leave it marked as unconfirmed rather than guessing. Omar can drive Monday and Wednesday after 1 pm, but his car is not wheelchair accessible. Lena is available Tuesday and Thursday at any time and has an accessible car. Pete can drive Friday only and has room for two passengers. The only other trip request so far is Sam's library visit on Thursday, pickup at 2 pm from 4 Cedar Court; no return time was given. I might send more names later, so don't fill gaps by making up drivers or rides. Make any uncovered trip easy to spot, and keep the dates within that week. a simple table is fine; do not install packages. Don't assign anyone to something their availability or vehicle can't support, and show the missing return details as unknown.", "output": "Create a volunteer transport rota for Riverside Neighbors covering Monday 14 to Sunday 20 October. Use a table with columns for date, pickup time and place, passenger, driver, and return details.

Include these requests and availability:
- Mrs Ellis needs a ride to the clinic on Tuesday 15 October. Pickup is at 8:30 am from 12 Mill Lane. Her return time is not known; mark it as unconfirmed rather than guessing.
- Omar can drive Monday and Wednesday after 1 pm. His car is not wheelchair accessible.
- Lena is available Tuesday and Thursday at any time and has an accessible car.
- Pete can drive Friday only and has room for two passengers.
- Sam has requested a library visit on Thursday, with pickup at 2 pm from 4 Cedar Court. No return time was given.

Keep the dates within that week. Do not make up drivers or rides to fill gaps. Make any uncovered trip easy to spot, and do not assign anyone to a trip that their availability or vehicle cannot support. Show missing return details as unknown. A simple table is fine; do not install packages."}]
